# Deutsche Welle (DW)
> Deutsche Welle is Germany’s international broadcaster, offering multilingual news, analysis, and background coverage on global affairs, business, culture, and learning German.

DW publishes international reporting in multiple languages, with major areas spanning breaking news, in-depth topic pages, video and audio journalism, fact-based explainers, and German-learning resources through DW Learn German.

## News
- [News](https://www.dw.com/en/top-stories/s-9097): Main English news hub covering global developments, politics, business, and society.
- [World](https://www.dw.com/en/world/s-1429): International news and analysis on major events across regions and countries.
- [Germany](https://www.dw.com/en/germany/s-1432): Coverage of German politics, society, economy, and domestic developments.
- [Europe](https://www.dw.com/en/europe/s-1433): Reporting and analysis on European Union affairs and regional politics.
- [Business](https://www.dw.com/en/business/s-1431): News on markets, trade, companies, energy, and the global economy.
- [Science](https://www.dw.com/en/science/s-20325): Reporting on research, climate, health, technology, and scientific developments.
- [Culture](https://www.dw.com/en/culture/s-1441): Articles on arts, media, literature, film, music, and cultural debates.
- [Sports](https://www.dw.com/en/sports/s-8171): International sports coverage, features, and tournament reporting.

## Regions & Geopolitics
- [Africa](https://www.dw.com/en/africa/s-12756): News and background reporting from across the African continent.
- [Asia](https://www.dw.com/en/asia/s-12758): Coverage of politics, economics, and society across Asia.
- [Middle East](https://www.dw.com/en/middle-east/s-12755): Reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, and regional developments in the Middle East.
- [Latin America](https://www.dw.com/en/latin-america/s-12757): News and analysis on politics, society, and economies in Latin America.
- [Ukraine](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine/t-60818746): Topic page aggregating DW reporting on Russia’s war against Ukraine.
- [Migration](https://www.dw.com/en/migration/t-18930382): Coverage of migration policy, refugee issues, and cross-border movement.
- [Human Rights](https://www.dw.com/en/human-rights/t-18911698): Reporting and explainers on rights issues, abuses, and advocacy worldwide.

## Topics & Explainers
- [Climate Change](https://www.dw.com/en/climate-change/t-18924637): Articles and features on climate policy, impacts, and environmental action.
- [Fact Check](https://www.dw.com/en/fact-check/s-5598): Verification-focused reporting that examines claims, misinformation, and online rumors.
- [Coronavirus](https://www.dw.com/en/coronavirus/t-54160671): Archived and ongoing reporting on the COVID-19 pandemic and public health.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.dw.com/en/artificial-intelligence/t-66943869): Coverage of AI policy, innovation, ethics, and industry developments.
- [Energy Transition](https://www.dw.com/en/energy-transition/t-36862416): Reporting on renewables, fossil fuels, and the shift in energy systems.
- [Opinion](https://www.dw.com/en/opinion/s-1433): Commentary and analysis from DW journalists and contributors.
- [In Depth](https://www.dw.com/en/in-depth/s-9097): Longer-form reporting and contextual journalism on major global issues.

## Video & TV
- [DW Video](https://www.dw.com/en/media-center/live-tv/s-100825): Live TV and video access through DW’s media center.
- [Media Center](https://www.dw.com/en/media-center/s-100824): Central hub for live streams, TV, audio, and on-demand media.
- [Documentaries](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/documentaries/s-3610): Documentary programming on politics, society, science, and culture.
- [Euromaxx](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/euromaxx/s-7555): Lifestyle and culture magazine featuring European trends and creative scenes.
- [Arts Unveiled](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/arts-unveiled/s-101798): Video stories and interviews from the worlds of art and culture.
- [Made in Germany](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/made-in-germany/s-3066): Business magazine covering innovation, industry, and economic trends.
- [Tomorrow Today](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/tomorrow-today/s-3298): Science and technology program focused on research and future-oriented topics.

## Audio & Podcasts
- [Podcasts](https://www.dw.com/en/podcasts/s-100977): DW podcast directory spanning news, culture, language, and analysis.
- [Inside Europe](https://www.dw.com/en/inside-europe/program-19028671): Weekly podcast and radio show on European politics and society.
- [The Day](https://www.dw.com/en/the-day/program-19129037): Daily news podcast explaining one major story in context.
- [Living Planet](https://www.dw.com/en/living-planet/program-19329534): Environmental podcast on climate, biodiversity, and sustainability.
- [On the Green Fence](https://www.dw.com/en/on-the-green-fence/program-56916677): Podcast exploring environmental and social issues in Africa.
- [Learning by Ear](https://www.dw.com/en/learning-by-ear/s-6809): Audio learning series combining storytelling and educational content.

## Learn German
- [Learn German](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/learn-german/s-9528): Main portal for German courses, exercises, and language-learning materials.
- [Nicos Weg](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/nicos-weg/c-36519789): Structured video-based German course for beginners through intermediate learners.
- [Deutschtrainer](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/deutschtrainer/c-56705109): Short practical lessons for everyday German vocabulary and phrases.
- [Harry – gefangen in der Zeit](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/harry-gefangen-in-der-zeit/c-51038037): Interactive German-learning series built around a narrative storyline.
- [Top-Thema](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/top-thema/s-55861562): Current affairs texts and audio for intermediate German learners.
- [Langsam gesprochene Nachrichten](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/langsam-gesprochene-nachrichten/s-60040332): News read slowly to support listening comprehension and vocabulary building.
- [Deutsch im Job](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/deutsch-im-job/s-32316): German lessons focused on workplace communication and professional contexts.
- [Placement Test](https://learngerman.dw.com/en/placementDashboard): Assessment tool for determining German language proficiency level.

## Programs & Shows
- [TV Programs](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/s-32688): Directory of DW television shows and recurring video formats.
- [Quadriga](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/quadriga/s-30486): Discussion program examining international politics and current affairs.
- [Conflict Zone](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/conflict-zone/s-101495): Hard-hitting interview format featuring political leaders and decision-makers.
- [Global Us](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/global-us/s-100843): Program exploring global issues through personal stories and reporting.
- [Shift](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/shift/s-30484): Digital culture and technology show covering innovation and online life.
- [Eco Africa](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/eco-africa/s-32684): Environmental reporting focused on sustainability and conservation in Africa.
- [Reporter](https://www.dw.com/en/tv/reporter/s-31617): Documentary-style field reporting from around the world.

- [DW Akademie](https://www.dw.com/en/dw-akademie/s-9519): DW’s international media development and journalism training organization.
